def prod(A, B, k, l, m):
    C = [[None for _ in range(m)] for _ in range(k)]

            ANS = 0
            for pl in range(l):

            C[i][j] = (A[i][j] + B[i][j]) % mod
    return C

def calculate_permutation_sum(N, M):

    ALL = N * (N - 1) // 2
    A = [[ALL - (N - 2) * 2, (N - 2) * 2, 0],
         [1, ALL - 1 - (N - 3), N - 3],
         [0, 4, ALL - 4]]
    POWA = [A]

        n -= 1 << (n.bit_length() - 1)

    AS = 0

        plus = (N - i) * (N - i + 1) // 2
        minus = (i - 1) * (i - 1 + 1) // 2

        ANS %= mod
